title: Yandex Direct - Apps on Google Play

facts.fact: The Yandex Direct Google Play listing was last updated on Oct 20, 2026.
Yandex describes Yandex Direct ads as appearing on Yandex and tens of thousands of partner sites.
facts.quote: Yandex Direct — ads on Yandex and tens of thousands partner sites.

facts.fact: According to the developer's reply to a 2022 review, payment in the app is available only in Russian rubles.
facts.quote: Payment is available only in Russian rubles in the application.

facts.fact: The developer's Google Play data safety section says the app may share Financial info, App activity and 2 other data types with third parties.
facts.quote: Financial info, App activity and 2 others

facts.fact: The developer's Google Play data safety section says the app may collect Personal info, Financial info and 5 other data types.
facts.quote: Personal info, Financial info and 5 others

facts.fact: The developer states that data is encrypted in transit and that users can request data deletion.
The app lets users set up campaigns with Easy Start and monitor key metrics for campaigns created in Direct Pro.
facts.quote: Set up campaigns with Easy Start, edit them, and track their performance

facts.fact: A user review dated Nov 11, 2025 claims that around 5% of necessary features work and that the app works only with the main account; this is a user claim, not a vendor figure.
facts.quote: Around 5% of necessary features work. Works with main account only
